"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Any Palestinian partner must recognize Israel's right to exist, reject violence, and adhere to existing agreements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
